scientific_question: Does preserving all 1536 GELU activation hyperplanes, with compact learned direction reassignment on both sides of the nonlinearity, recover the complete sparse-MoE expert function and input tangent that rank-561 post-GELU mixing could not?

evidence_chain: The sealed global-write audit proves that a shared output atlas is not the binding constraint: rank 561 recovers heldout routed output 0.9305, analytic input JVP 0.7850, and weakest-expert output 0.8788.
Four post-GELU Givens stages causally improve mean heldout recovery by 0.1059 to 0.1098 over an exact diagonal control, proving that coefficient-to-write reassignment matters.
The same candidate still recovers only 0.5809 to 0.5827 mean output and negative input JVP, so 561 already-formed ridge responses are not a sufficient nonlinear feature dictionary.

For non-affine GELU, S GELU(z) is not equal to GELU(S z). Mixing after GELU can reassign existing features but cannot create new activation hyperplanes; the direction-changing map must therefore be tested before GELU while preserving the teacher hidden width.

The matrix-normal KFAC chart is the strongest stable prior family at about 0.70 output and 0.417 JVP recovery. It shows that a functional metric helps, but its fixed dense base and covariance roots are nondeployable and its nonlinear tangent remains insufficient.
theory.candidate_formula: For global normalized U in R^(480x768), fixed bank-specific orthonormal V in R^(768x480), and node n=(layer,expert): z=Rin_n(Ux); p=S_n(z); h=GELU(g_n elementwise p + b_n); q=Rout_n(T_n(h)); f_n(x)=V(d_n elementwise q). Rin and Rout are one learned disjoint-Givens stage each. S_n is a fixed signed normalized-FHT expansion 480->1536 and T_n is an independently signed normalized-FHT contraction 1536->480.
theory.activation_width_argument: S_n maps the compact input chart into 1536 distinct pre-GELU coordinates, so GELU acts on the full teacher hidden width. T_n is applied only after these nonlinear features have formed. This tests the location of mixing, not another post-GELU rank or stage sweep.
theory.procedural_expansion: Pad the 480-vector to 2048, multiply by a frozen node-specific Rademacher sign vector, apply the normalized 2048-point FHT, multiply by an independent frozen sign vector, retain coordinates [0:1536], and scale by sqrt(2048/480) so each retained preactivation has the same expected coordinate variance as the rank-480 input chart.
theory.procedural_contraction: Pad the 1536-vector to 2048, multiply by a third frozen node-specific sign vector, apply the normalized 2048-point FHT, multiply by a fourth frozen sign vector, retain coordinates [0:480], and scale by sqrt(2048/1536) so each output coordinate preserves expected activation variance.
theory.normalization: Rows of U are normalized in every forward pass and scaled by 0.02*sqrt(768), matching the preceding sealed oracle. V is the sealed bank-specific orthonormal write basis truncated to rank 480. Givens stages preserve norm; only explicit hidden and output gains control amplitude.
theory.why_not_lora: There is no dense expert base, no retained dense c_fc or c_proj matrix, and no additive residual. U, V, procedural S/T, node-specific gain/bias, and two compact Givens stages define the complete expert function.
theory.paper_reconciliation: The original Mapping Networks paper motivates compact modulation, local smoothness, and layer-wise charts. Here hidden gain/bias are structured modulation; analytic input-JVP loss is a direct local functional smoothness/tangent constraint; and every layer/expert owns compact chart coordinates while dense directions are shared and counted. This is a theory-guided transformer adaptation, not a claim to reproduce the paper's exact CNN parameter generator.

candidate.name: global_rank480_fullwidth_pregelu_dual_givens
candidate.procedural_node_seed_rule: seed = procedural_map_seed + 10007*layer + 1009*expert + 97*map_index, with map_index 0,1,2,3 for expansion-input, expansion-output, contraction-input, contraction-output signs

location_control.name: global_rank480_fullwidth_fixed_mixing
location_control.description: Identical full-width S/T chart with both learned Givens stages fixed to identity. U, V, signs, hidden gain/bias, output gain, data, initialization, and fitting protocol are otherwise identical.

data_protocol.sampling: Use exact terminal top-2 routing and deterministic per-expert samples. Fit discovery A and B independently. Heldout tokens and probes never affect topology, coordinates, stopping, thresholds, or candidate/control choice.

fit_protocol.target: Dense complete-expert routed output and analytic input-JVP, expressed in the bank-specific fixed rank-480 global write basis.
fit_protocol.objective: Equal-layer/equal-expert normalized coefficient MSE plus 1.0 times normalized analytic coefficient-JVP MSE. Equal normalized weighting is frozen because tangent failure, not endpoint fit, is the binding diagnosis.
fit_protocol.optimizer: AdamW on normalized feature raw coordinates, hidden gains, hidden biases, output gains, and candidate Givens angles. V and procedural S/T signs are fixed but V is counted.
fit_protocol.precision: float32 fitting/scoring with float32 orthonormal V loaded from the sealed float64 eigensystem audit
fit_protocol.selection: Use the final registered step. Do not choose a step, LR, rank, FHT sign seed, Givens matching, loss weight, or checkpoint on heldout recovery.

control_escape_gate.purpose: Avoid discarding a simpler full-width solution if learned Givens are unnecessary.
control_escape_gate.rule: If the location control independently clears every absolute output, layer, expert, JVP, action-agreement, occupancy, finiteness, and compression gate in both banks, seal it as a separate structural pass even if the candidate causal-gain gates fail. Do not choose between candidate and control on heldout values.

decision_rule.prerequisite_fail: If the truncated rank-480 sealed write bases or exact procedural-map identities fail any prerequisite, stop before fitting and close this allocation without trying another rank, padded width, or sign seed.
decision_rule.candidate_pass: Candidate passes only if both independent banks clear every absolute gate and improve both output and JVP recovery over the identical fixed-mixing location control by at least 0.05. A pass authorizes only theory and preregistration for causal step-zero chart acquisition and a separate initialization/Mapping-Loss shadow; terminal-derived U/V remain nondeployable.
decision_rule.control_escape_pass: The control may independently establish that full-width pre-GELU procedural mixing is sufficient under the frozen control escape gate. That outcome authorizes only a separately preregistered causal acquisition test of the simpler control; it does not retroactively pass the learned-Givens causal treatment.
decision_rule.fail: If neither the candidate nor the control escape clears the absolute gates, close the exact rank-480, 2048-FHT, full-width pre-GELU S/T chart. Do not sweep rank, width, signs, stages, matching, seed, LR, optimizer, steps, JVP weight, activation, regularizers, or thresholds. Reconcile the result with the KFAC and write ceilings before any new family.

systems.performance_gate: Run committed-source tests and an exact rank480/hidden1536/1024-sample candidate-control two-step preflight with materialized node-specific signs. Foreground-poll only if the complete frozen oracle projects to <=5 minutes; otherwise launch a persistent watcher through committed launch_local_detached.py and verify its atomic receipt immediately.
systems.callback_policy: For a run projected to finish in one to two hours, terminal success and actionable failure only. Add a 90-minute resettable heartbeat only if measured or observed runtime exceeds two hours. Every invocation must mention @Codex and carry the event-specific causal continuation prompt.
